context: Evaluates whether the agent answers "what's left" from the goal file and reports the rendered summary verbatim, preserving the cap, the ordering, and the awaiting/parked distinctions, rather than expanding it into prose. Covers Workflow step 4 and the 'never paraphrase the summary' anti-pattern.

checklist.name: Reads the goal file
checklist.description: Status is sourced from the active goal file rather than reconstructed from conversation memory

checklist.name: Next action leads
checklist.description: The single next action appears first in the response, before any context or counts

checklist.name: Counts match the file
checklist.description: Reports 2 of 4 done, matching the file rather than a recount

checklist.name: Awaiting item surfaced as needing confirmation
checklist.description: The awaiting item is described as needing the user's confirmation, not as done

checklist.name: Awaiting not buried in todo
checklist.description: The awaiting item is distinguished from ordinary outstanding work rather than listed among the todo items

checklist.name: Parked work reported
checklist.description: The parked item is reported as parked to follow-ups, so the user can see work left the goal

checklist.name: Summary not expanded to prose
checklist.description: The summary is not rewritten into paragraphs or a session narrative

checklist.name: No unrequested detail added
checklist.description: No per-item status table or commentary on each item is added beyond what was rendered

checklist.name: Length stays within the cap
checklist.description: Summary content stays at or below roughly 100 words

checklist.name: File path offered, not pasted
checklist.description: The goal file path is offered for detail rather than its contents being reproduced
